steps.intent: Open the servicing console entry screen
Enter the operator user ID to sign on to the servicing console.
steps.target: textbox "User ID" in OPERATOR SIGN ON (textbox labelled "User ID")

steps.intent: Enter the operator password to sign on to the servicing console.
steps.target: password "Password" in OPERATOR SIGN ON (password labelled "Password")

steps.intent: Click the Sign On button to log in to the servicing console with the entered credentials.
steps.target: button "Sign On" in OPERATOR SIGN ON (button "Sign On")

steps.intent: Click Member Servicing in the top menu to begin looking up a member.
steps.target: link "Member Servicing" in Meridian Credit Union • Member Servicing Console (link "Member Servicing" @navFrame)

steps.intent: Enter the member ID to look up member {{input.memberId}} for servicing.
steps.target: textbox "Member ID" in MEMBER SERVICING – INQUIRY (textbox labelled "Member ID" @bodyFrame)

steps.intent: Click the Search button to look up member {{input.memberId}} and access their profile for account servicing.
Click the Open Sub-Account link to begin opening a new sub-account for member {{input.memberId}}.
steps.target: link "Open Sub-Account" in SHARE / DEPOSIT ACCOUNTS (link "Open Sub-Account" @bodyFrame)

steps.intent: Enter the description for the new sub-account as '{{input.description}}'.
steps.target: textbox "Description" in OPEN SUB-ACCOUNT – REQUEST (textbox labelled "Description" @bodyFrame)

steps.intent: Enter the initial deposit amount of {{input.initialDeposit}} for the new sub-account.
steps.target: textbox "Initial Deposit" in OPEN SUB-ACCOUNT – REQUEST (textbox labelled "Initial Deposit" @bodyFrame)

steps.intent: Submit the request to open a new sub-account for member {{input.memberId}} with the specified description and initial deposit.
steps.target: button "Submit Request" in OPEN SUB-ACCOUNT – REQUEST (button "Submit Request" @bodyFrame)

steps.intent: Record the new account number for the sub-account that was just opened.
steps.target: cell "New Account Number" in SUB-ACCOUNT OPENED (cell "New Account Number" @bodyFrame)

steps.intent: Record the confirmation reference for the newly opened sub-account to complete the process.
steps.target: cell "Confirmation Reference" in SUB-ACCOUNT OPENED (cell "Confirmation Reference" @bodyFrame)
